questions.question: Which two stages make up photosynthesis, and what does each stage produce?

Which life cycle do plants retain, and how does it differ from the animal life cycle?
How do potassium ions and osmosis cause a stoma to open and close?
What does mycorrhiza help the plant absorb, and what does the plant exchange with the fungus?
Which root zone absorbs water and nutrients, and what develops there?
How do onion seeds and bean seeds differ in endosperm and cotyledon structure?
What two products are formed when the two sperm cells take part in double fertilization?
What are the two types of pollination, and which agents can carry out cross-pollination?
